macros.name: catanlegend
macros.doc: a resource color legend centered at height y (in cm; -6.6 sits below a default-scale framed board).

macros.name: hexauto
macros.doc: selector-aware: renders \hexfull when the hex matches a highlight declaration (Section 5.3), \hexdim otherwise.

macros.name: hexdim
macros.doc: desaturated gray hex with a muted token; the backdrop for highlight figures.

macros.name: hexfull
macros.doc: \hexfull{q}{r}{res}{n} — colored hex, resource glyph (if icons are on), number token with probability pips, 6 and 8 in red.

macros.name: hexprob
macros.doc: neutral cream fill with full-color tokens; a “probability view” that isolates the number layer.

macros.name: port
macros.doc: a harbor badge off the named coastal side of a land hex, with piers to the two vertices it serves. type is generic (3:1) or a resource name (2:1 with a colored ring and swatch).

macros.name: portauto
macros.doc: extends selection to harbors: a resource port renders in full color when its resource is declared via \hlres, and desaturated (\portdim) otherwise.

macros.name: road
macros.doc: a road along the named edge, drawn with a darker outline for contrast on any terrain.

macros.name: robber
macros.doc: the robber figure, offset beside the token position.

macros.name: standardboard
macros.doc: \standardboard and \standardports are a built-in legal example layout: correct tile and token multisets, no two red (6/8) tokens adjacent, a token-free desert, and a standardstyle port arrangement.

macros.name: standardports
macros.doc: \standardboard and \standardports are a built-in legal example layout: correct tile and token multisets, no two red (6/8) tokens adjacent, a token-free desert, and a standardstyle port arrangement.
